title: Collection of Biological Samples From Patients With Echinococcosis and Implementation of a Home-made PCR Method
official: Pilot Observational Study Involving the Collection of Biological Samples and Clinical Data From Patients With Echinococcosis: Implementation and Evaluation of a Home-made PCR Method
summary: Echinococcosis is a zoonotic disease caused by Echinococcus species. Diagnosis currently relies on imaging, serology and microscopy, but microscopy is time-consuming, has limited sensitivity and cannot distinguish between Echinococcus species. Molecular methods such as PCR may therefore provide a faster, more sensitive and species-specific diagnostic approach, with both clinical and epidemiological value. This study aims to improve molecular diagnosis and knowledge of pulmonary echinococcosis.

interventions.name: Collection of biological samples from echinococcosis patients for the development of a home-based PCR protocol for diagnostic use.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected diagnosis of echinococcosis
* Patients requiring surgery to remove cysts
* Patients aged 6 years or over
* Signature of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are candidates for surgery for other reasons
